rebuttals.argument: The integrated ruling accurately reflects Starbucks' (home) round 3 commitments: continuing the 20% peak café capacity reservation, expanding dynamic slot release to all pilot cafés after 08:00 if in-café demand is low, and pre-committing to rollback if adverse effects are measured. All actions remain within the pilot, staffing, and measurement constraints described in the Starbucks dossier. No unmeasured outcomes are asserted as fact, and the public_strategy_history is properly updated. No causal link in the ruling conflicts with Starbucks' capabilities, constraints, or red lines.
